item.title: Netanyahu strikes out in Washington
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu made a hasty trip to Washington this week to push Donald Trump toward war with Iran. Although little has been made public from the meeting, it appears Netanyahu has failed — for now.

item.title: UK court rules that the government ban on Palestine Action is unlawful
item.description: In a blow to Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s government, London’s High Court has ruled that the ban on Palestine Action is unlawful.

item.title: How Israel is eroding life for Palestinians in the West Bank
item.description: Israeli violence in the West Bank isn't as dramatic as in Gaza, but it is methodical, durable, and sometimes harder to understand. Here’s how Israel is using settler terror, financial policies, and legal tactics to suffocate Palestinian life.

item.title: Film Review: When Palestinian peasants brought an empire to its knees
item.description: Annemarie Jacir's 'Palestine 36' gets a lot right in telling the story of the 1936 Palestinian revolution against the British. But a better accounting of the class dynamics in the uprising could have helped explain why it was crushed.

item.title: Organizers fight back as Missouri moves to crack down on Israel-related speech in schools
item.description: Rights groups warn HB 2061 will be used to silence criticisms of Israel and attack Missouri teachers.

item.title: Palestinian resistance and the trap of Trump’s ‘Board of Peace’
item.description: The Palestinian resistance faces a dilemma with Trump’s 'Board of Peace': reject it and risk annihilation, or engage and risk normalizing permanent occupation.

item.title: Can activists stop NYC from reinvesting in Israel Bonds?
item.description: NYC comptroller Mark Levine says he will resume investing city pensions in Israel Bonds, but a growing campaign of organizations and lawmakers aims to stop him.

item.title: The Palestinians stuck in the no-man’s-land of Jerusalem and the Israeli settlement plan to expel them
item.description: Tens of thousands of Palestinians in the Qalandia refugee camp and Kufr Aqab are cut off from Jerusalem by the apartheid wall and separated from other Palestinian towns. Now, a new Israeli settlement plan threatens to displace them completely.

item.title: How Jesse Jackson helped bring Arab-Americans into the political process
item.description: James Zogby talks to Mondoweiss about his late friend, Jesse Jackson, and his enduring legacy among Arab-Americans.

item.title: Trump appears to be gearing up to attack Iran. How close are we to war?
item.description: Donald Trump says he will decide whether to attack Iran within the next 10 days. Mondoweiss talks with Center for International Policy Senior Fellow Sina Toossi about Trump’s threats, Israel's role, and how Iran might respond if the US starts a war.
